The number of people working as bank tellers has dropped by about 50% over the last 15 years. The number of typists (people who type drafts, often hand written or dictated to tape, an type them) has decreased by over 80% from the 1940s till today. There are 75% fewer farmers today than in 1900. So, sometimes new technologies decrease the number of workers in a field. AGI and SuperAGI are different than other past technologies IMHO. If computers and robots can be better than the average person in 99% of jobs, the world changes a lot. (What do I mean by better? I mean that it would cost less to get and maintain a robot doing the job for 5 years than it would cost to hire and pay a human to do the job and the robot does the job better than the human.)
